newsitem.title: NIGERIA: SOBER AS A JUDGE IS THE RULE IN EASTERN NIGERIA.
newsitem.headline: SOBER AS A JUDGE IS THE RULE IN EASTERN NIGERIA.

text.p: Judges of traditional courts in eastern Nigeria's Abia state have been told to stop drinking beer and palm wine in local bars to preserve an image of sobriety, a newspaper said on Tuesday.

The Daily Times quoted court president M.N. Mba as telling judges: "Drinking beer and palm wine in bars or parlours with everybody is not in consonance with judiciary ethics on discipline, decency and decorum."
